brief.issue: a fracture missed on X-ray at an emergency department and the patient sent home as a sprain

items.title: Failure to conduct an adequate medical assessment and to order an x-ray — Health & Disability Commissioner
items.quote: The Commissioner found that by failing to conduct an adequate medical assessment that took full account of the woman’s symptoms, and by not obtaining an X-ray of her hip, the doctor failed to provide services with reasonable care and skill and breached Right 4(1)[1] of the Code of Health and Disability Services Consumers’ Rights (the Code).
items.why: An HDC decision found a doctor breached Right 4(1) by inadequate assessment and not obtaining an X-ray for a suspected fracture.

items.title: Care of woman with hand injury — Health & Disability Commissioner
items.quote: Accordingly, Dr C did not provide services to Ms A with reasonable care and skill, and so breached Right 4(1) of the Code of Health and Disability Services Consumers' Rights (the Code).
items.why: An HDC decision found Dr C breached Right 4(1), which supports citing the reasonable care and skill standard.

items.why: This HDC decision says the doctor was found in breach of Right 4(1), supporting the standard expected in assessment and follow-up.

items.title: Emergency departments (ED)
items.quote: If your condition gets worse, or you do not get better at home, contact your regular healthcare provider or return to the emergency department.
items.why: This gives discharge advice to seek further help or return to ED if not improving, which is relevant to safety-netting after being sent home.
